test_title: PYST 57: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘T + U’ means ‘T is the mother of U’.

‘T – U’ means ‘T is the father of U’.

‘T $ U’ means ‘T is the husband of U’.

‘T # U’ means ‘T is the daughter of U’.

If A # C $ V + X, then how is A related to X?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b179341100c8a851a46dc1aeabdc53868fb34279e298fc2277f663263597bc68.png] 

Code and their meaning:

Meaning

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
Husband

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 
 

 

Given expression: A # C $ V + X

1) A is the daughter of C

2) C is the husband of V

3) V is the mother of X

Draw family tree accordingly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/336c03f4ce88b7e33dc522d6df219983727124d765467f1b4bb0de712203b565.png] 

So, A is the sister of X.

 

Hence, ‘Option 2’ is the correct answer.
